svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: Kinfolk release
svg.desc: Kinfolk release. 10 components in 3 groups. Connections: Push to main to Build and promote (every push); Push to main to Apply migrations (server paths); Push to main to Build the SPA (UI paths); Build and promote to Vercel production (promote); Apply migrations to Neon Postgres (committed SQL); Apply migrations to Wait for the commit; Wait for the commit to Vercel production (same sha); Build the SPA to Publish and verify; Publish and verify to Pages site (deploy-pages); Vercel production to Nightly health; Pages site to Nightly health.

text.tspan: A push to main starts up to three independent paths; Vercel can promote before the migration finishes
